notes.title: Russian version now live!
notes.content:
[h2]Quick Intro [/h2]

After months of hard work from Dicur3x, Vieros and I, CYE is now fully available in Russian!

The whole game is identical to the English version minus the actual English. It is a nice feeling making CYE more available to people, not 100% sure on future translations at this point of time due to how time consuming it was. However, I do have a translation template written out, so the option is always there =) 


Many thanks <3

notes.title: The Mum vs Mom update.
notes.content:
[h3]Quick intro[/h3]

I was watching a twitch stream over on GameLuster last night and I never noticed how much of the dialogue has been entangled with both American and British terminology! As the game is set in the states and I happen to be a UK citizen, there was a large number of Mums I'd managed to unintentionally sneaked in without realizing. 

[h3]List of changes[/h3]

- Changed all the Mum, Mummy words into Moms and Mommy's.

- Capitalized all Dads, Daddy, Moms and Mommy.

- Changed the Accident and Emergencies sign at the hospital, into the Emergency Room.

- Added animated arrows above the subway, it's actually surprisingly easy to miss and has been mentioned a couple of times.

- Added two syringes on the subway train.

- Added the word battery on the graffiti at the hospital. It's a nightmare to collect them and I hope it will help people in the future.
 
- Big change! You no longer have to use the syringe to refill running stamina, it will recharge by itself after some time. To balance this, I made the stamina bar deplete quicker and made the recharge time more than 10 seconds. It's just so players don't run past the whole game but are able to escape tricky situations when required. Syringes still work as a refill.


[h3]Quick outro[/h3]

I don't have opportunities to watch playthroughs to be honest, there's not that many videos out there but they do help me tremendously. I am making a new game at the moment (Still a long way off) and I'm thinking of getting testers to record their playthroughs during the development stage to see how they play. 

Keep you all in the loop :D

notes.title: Upcoming Price Cut.
notes.content:
[h2]Quick Intro [/h2]

There’s going to be a planned upcoming price cut that I’ve been meaning to do for a while now, will go into effect once the sale has finished. Also gave me an excuse to add/change a couple of things around :> 

[h2]Changes [/h2]

- Implemented a new mid-credit scene. Originally wanted to create the extra ending back in mid development but opted out due to how dark and ambiguous it was, definitely adds an extra layer to the events of the game. Hope people love it as much as I do :D 

- Consequently as a side effect of the mid credit scene, I did have to change one crucial detail in the ending sequence for it to fit better. With the confusing “Two years ago?” being switched to “One year later?” the meaning of scene hasn’t changed just the time period, plus it’s less confusing.

- The Head teacher in the school level now appears in other areas whilst playing as Jake. Wanted to make it look like she was hunting the player, rather than hanging outside the laundry room the whole time 

- Reduced the head teachers HP a little bit more.

- Reworded ten pieces of dialogue to clarify some plot points better.

- Cut the delay before pressing E to finish sentences in cut scenes from 30 frames down to 1 frame. Really helpful for fast readers and people replaying the game again.

- Added an extra enemy in the Church, nightclub, park and news station sections of the game.

- Added ten handgun ammo to Chloe’s inventory before escaping to the Church.

- Fixed some wall clipping in the hospital.

- Moved ammo more central in some rooms. Don’t have to run to the other side to open a draw.


[h3]Quick Outro[/h3]

Anyway I hope that’s it for now besides potentially fixing undiscovered bugs. Even though I said in the prior update that I was finished, I did wanted to do a small update before the price cut comes into effect. Future wise, I’ll be exploring translating the game into different languages.

Many thanks <3

notes.title: Final update
notes.content:
[h2]Quick Intro [/h2]

After almost a year of updates and fixes, it's time to say goodbye. It's not as expansive as prior changes but it's stuff I wanted to add the first time around.


[h2]Changes [/h2]

- Additional NPCs early game. Inside the school and outside Chloe's house.

- New ladder section after the school mid game.  

- Created a chase sequence just before Chloe enters the hospital.

- Shortened the two cutscenes in the car.

- Fixed a couple of graphical errors with some enemy sprites

- There's now a special room before you meet Rupert.

- Some of the enemies have pogo sticks in the school section.

- The Hotel level now has messages cropping up on the walls.

- Switched the location of the Valve key item in the hotel, don't have to go to the other side of the building to acquire said item.

- Knocked down the HP for the final boss.

- Changed some of the floor tiles in the final level.

- Furniture in the art exhibit.

- Metal detector graphic and SFX added in before the boss fight in the forest 

- Extra puzzle in the last level.

- More handgun ammo in the early stages.

-More enemies in the final level.


[h3]Quick Outro[/h3]

Thank you to everyone who supported the game for the last year. Even though it fell short in my expectations, I came away proud with what I made and the lessons learnt along the way. I will still answer questions in the community hub and offer support with regards to questions. There will be a announcement on the 6th of November, which will coincide with the one year anniversary of release. 

Happy Halloween <3

notes.title: CYE Remix update.
notes.content:
[h2]Quick Intro [/h2]

Wasn't 100% sure what to call this update. Even though I've made many changes, I was half tempted to call it a special edition but there's not a vast amount of new content to qualify as such. Best call it a remix for now.


[h2]Key changes [/h2]

[h3]Cutscenes[/h3]

- Chloe, Bella, Rupert, Sally, Jake and Sandra now have more facial expressions in story segments.   

- The moon ellipse from the trailers is back in the game. Was originally removed before launch due to early game pacing issues.

- General wait time between dialogue has been cut down by 75%. Now measuring at 0.25 seconds.

- Small dialogue change in the subway and prior final boss. 

- Slight extension to the subway crash.

- Screen text on Chloes thoughts after exiting the radio station.

- Small grammar fixes.


[h3]Gameplay[/h3]

- New gameplay segment in the Radio Station. Be quick on the movement keys! 

- Three of the side buildings in between the Church and the Hotel have been moved elsewhere. Purely to help with early game pacing. 

- Some of the bigger side buildings have unlockable shortcuts back to their respective entrances, reducing instances of backtracking

- The Door Store has been completely removed, served no purpose.

- New requirement to gain entry to the Radio station. Wanted to have another ladder section.

- New requirement to gain entry to the School. Wanted to have another bed section.

- Running stamina lasts a little longer.

- Handgun damage has been reduced slightly, most enemies require one additional shot. Help encourage the player to use other weapons more.

- Added slightly more 9mm ammo early game to help compensate for reduced handgun damage.

- Added a couple of shotgun shell pickups.

- Three new enemies. Introduced in the nightclub, sewers and the first house on the way to the Hotel.

- Baby spiders now have an accompanying sound effect to warn players that they’re in the area.

- Reduced Donald and Ruperts firearm damage late game.

- Reduced the Headteachers hit points for her respective boss battle.

- Other small changes I can’t recall off the top of my head.


[h3]Music[/h3] 

- Music volume has been increased by 30%.

- Replaced almost all the interior music in nonstory areas, every building now has their own theme. Beforehand there used to be only one song that was played. Please note it is existing music repurposed with different speed/pitches and not new recordings.


[h3]Quick Outro[/h3]

Most of the changes have been done in relation to feedback in the last few months, hopefully it’ll turn out to be a much better experience in the long run.

notes.title: CYE update 2.0
notes.content:
[h2]Key changes[/h2]

[h3]Reworked the running system.[/h3]
It now no longer recharges over time and is instead refilled by the syringe, adding an extra element of item management. The reasoning behind the change, is due to how people engaged with the game when the original update was implemented. 

I noticed players used to run past enemies and speed through most of the game, having way too much ammo and syringes by the end. To help with this change, I added food items for people to eat in order to recharge some stamina, along with an extra syringe early game. I’ll revert the changes if it’s unpopular.

[h3]More interaction[/h3]
There are six Television Sets the player can turn on and off in the game world, each with unique animations and sound effects. 


[h3]Cutscenes[/h3] 
-Sally now smiles when teasing Jake (After the Hotel)
-Chloe now hugs Sally after rescuing her. (Art Exhibit)


[h3]More background effects [/h3]
Glowing street lamps. Water dripping from the ceiling. Radio Station sign now flickers. Outside extractor fans. Windows have faces looking outside. Kitchen sinks now have water bobbing up and down. 


[h3]Other changes [/h3]

-The player no longer auto equips the handgun after cutscenes.

-Two extra save cats in the Hotel.

-Three new enemies introduced.

-Switched two enemy types outside the hospital. 

-Added one extra cardboard box in the houses leading up to the hotel.

-Changed enemy movement speed in the subway.

-Changed some floor tiles in the last level.

-Added eight edible cakes throughout the game. Restores 10% health and 50% stamina.





[h3]Future[/h3]

There might be one more extra update for CYE before saying goodbye. Despite being under the radar since release, I’m very proud of the game and how it came to be :)

notes.title: CYE Update 1.7
notes.content:
[h2]Key changes[/h2]

[h3]Cutscenes[/h3] 

-Chloe now hugs Jake after rescuing him. Slight dialogue change (School)

-The headteacher now turns her head when she hears a knock on the door. Slight dialogue change. (School)

-Buttons now appears in the end cutscene. Slight dialogue change for Rupert. (His original line was way too cheesy)


[h3]New background effects[/h3]

Wall monitors, computers and security cameras now display different animations. 


[h3]Other changes[/h3]

-The headteacher boss now has less hitpoints. No longer being the bullet sponge that she was.

-Fixed passability issues in the subway.

-Shortened a couple of wait internals between dialogue. 

-Running is now enabled for the final boss.


[h3]Future[/h3]

I will continue to add new background effects, character animations and enemy redesigns in the coming months.

notes.title: CYE Update 1.6
notes.content:
[h1]Key Changes[/h1]

[h2]New running mechanic. [/h2]

With a regenerative stamina bar, the player can now hold shift to run in any direction. Once emptied, wait for the bar to start recharging to run again.

Consequently, holding Left Shift won't bring up the cursor for combat and is now strictly for Mouse Right only.

[b]Known issues with regards to running.[/b]

- Slight character frame skip when running diagonally.

- Holding Left Shift and Mouse Right at the same time will deplete the stamina bar, despite the player not actually running.

[h3]Other changes[/h3]

- Rejigged boss encounters to balance out the new mechanic. (Running is disabled for the final boss and therefore remains untouched)

- Created running sprites for Donald, Rupert and Sandra. 

- Added shotgun shells outside the hospital.

- Added three enemies outside the hospital.

- Changed the screen tone inside the building complex that houses the "Building a ramp" segment.

- Fixed a tile error in Verwood news corp.

notes.title: CYE Update 10/11/20
notes.content:
[h2]Key changes[/h2]

[h3]You can now go back to the title screen by pressing Esc.[/h3] 

Only works outside of cutscenes. If one is already in a playthrough, you’ll have to wait until after the next cutscene for it to activate.

[h3]Use syringe with Left mouse click when equipped.[/h3]

No longer have to reach over to the other side of the keyboard in order to heal up. Can still use the “I” key, just in case your muscle memory is playing up.

[h2]Fixes.[/h2]

-Fixed passibility issues.

-Fixed a glitch in the art gallery, where it incorrectly told the player that the door was unlocked.
